people.name: Hananiah
people.line: A false prophet who opposed Jeremiah's prophecies.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the bar from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
translations.bsb: But shortly after Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke off his neck, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:
translations.kjv: Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
